name: Jörgen Warborn - Article 3 – alinéa 1 – point 2 – sous-point b – sous-point ii; Article 5 – paragraphe 2 – alinéa 3 – point b – sous-point ii - Am 264
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
section: Article 3 – paragraph 1 – point 2 – point b – point ii
part_text: (ii) to issuers as defined in Article 2(1), point (d) of Directive 2004/109/EC which are parent undertakings of a large group which, on its balance sheet dates, exceed the average number of 5000 employees, and a net turnover of EUR 1 000 000 000, on a consolidated basis, during the financial year;
